notes.title: Patch notes for v1.3 of BOLSHEVIKTION 3D
notes.notes:
Patch notes for v1.3 of BOLSHEVIKTION 3D

[list]
[*] Smooth rendering, especially noticable while circlestrafing.
[*] Enemy blocking will be eased up when the player has their knife equipped.
[*] A linux version crash when music is changed is fixed.
[*] Occasional crashes on startup is fixed.
[*] Loading a game in the end-level screen to the same level as just finished no longer soft-locks you in that level.
[*] System messages can be seen when invulnerability enabled.
[*] You can no longer save during intermission screens, leading to undefined behaviour in-game.
[*] Autorun/FPS/Detail/FOV changed with the keyboard shortcuts will now save over multiple instances of the game running.
[*] Right click now opens doors properly
[*] Dying transitions are now at 2x speed
[*] Across the board performance improvements
[*] Music transitions are more natural
[*] FOV unmapped from mouse scrollwheel
[/list]
